title: Eurozone bond yields fall as lower energy prices ease inflation concerns - The Economic Times
text:
On Tuesday, government bond yields in the Eurozone experienced a notable drop, particularly for French and Italian bonds. The easing of inflation worries, attributed to falling oil and natural gas prices, enhanced demand for bonds. Germany's 10-year bond yield fell to 3.25%, while France's decreased to 4.69%. Boosted by the US President's calming remarks, market sentiment improved, especially for nations that had faced challenges in their bond markets.
